wikirealms-app-name: Product name. Do not translate “Wiki”; keep “Realms” or transliterate.
wikirealms-launch-pitch: Short pitch on the opening screen explaining what the app does.
wikirealms-launch-suggestions-label: Heading above curated English Wikipedia starting points.
wikirealms-launch-surprise: Button that opens a random curated English article.
wikirealms-launch-how: Button that opens the field guide / about panel.
wikirealms-launch-back: Accessible name for closing the launch screen when a world is already open.
wikirealms-launch-dialog-label: Accessible name for the launch dialog when summoned over a live world.
wikirealms-search-placeholder: Search field placeholder. $1 is the English name of the Wikipedia language (e.g. German).
wikirealms-search-language: Accessible label for the Wikipedia language selector next to search.
wikirealms-search-articles: Accessible label for the article search text field.
wikirealms-search-nothing-found: Shown when a search returns no results. $1 is the query.
wikirealms-search-close: Accessible name for closing the search palette.
wikirealms-search-sheet-label: Accessible label for the search sheet.
wikirealms-search-travel-label: Header above the search field in the command palette.
wikirealms-search-hint: Hint under an idle search palette. $1 is the Escape key label (e.g. Esc).
wikirealms-scrim-home: Accessible name for the home / opening-screen control.
wikirealms-scrim-trail: Visible label for the trail button.
wikirealms-scrim-trail-aria: Accessible name for the trail button. $1 is the number of realms.
wikirealms-scrim-travel: Accessible name for the back/forward navigation group.
wikirealms-scrim-tools: Accessible name for the overflow tools control on small screens.
wikirealms-scrim-settings: Visible and accessible label for Settings.
wikirealms-settings-wikipedia: Settings group legend for Wikipedia options.
wikirealms-settings-show-all-wikipedias: Checkbox label to list every Wikipedia in the search language picker.
wikirealms-settings-show-all-wikipedias-: Help text under the show-all-Wikipedias checkbox.
wikirealms-settings-rendering: Settings group legend for rendering quality.
wikirealms-settings-rendering-aria: Accessible name for the rendering quality control group.
wikirealms-settings-travel-animation: Checkbox label for the travel camera dive.
wikirealms-settings-map-layers: Settings group legend for map layers.
wikirealms-settings-panels: Settings group legend for panel chrome.
wikirealms-settings-chrome-aria: Accessible name for the panel presence control group.
wikirealms-settings-chrome-help: Help text under panel presence options.
wikirealms-share-link-copied: Toast after a share link is copied.
wikirealms-share-copy-failed: Toast when copying a link fails.
wikirealms-share-explore: Share sheet text. $1 is the article title.
wikirealms-load-article-failed: Error when an article cannot be loaded.
wikirealms-trail-cleared: Toast after the trail is cleared.
wikirealms-show-interface: Accessible name for revealing the HUD after it was hidden.
wikirealms-dismiss-hint: Accessible name for dismissing a tip.
wikirealms-share-need-realm: Disabled share hint when no realm is open.
wikirealms-share-realm-hint: Hint under share-realm when title unknown.
wikirealms-share-realm-hint-named: Hint under share-realm. $1 is the article title.
wikirealms-share-trail-hint: Hint under share-trail. $1 is the number of realms.
wikirealms-helm-shape: Accessible name for the world-shape radio group.
wikirealms-legend-close: Accessible name for closing the legend.
wikirealms-legend-dismiss-desktop: How to dismiss the legend on desktop.
wikirealms-legend-dismiss-mobile: How to dismiss the legend on mobile.
wikirealms-legend-ceiling-note: Note that greens depend on overall article citation quality.
wikirealms-legend-portal-detail: Detail for portals. $1 max portals; $2 max per range.
wikirealms-legend-snow-label: Legend entry for rock and snow.
wikirealms-legend-snow-detail: Detail for rock/snow. $1 rock start; $2 rock full; $3 snow start (percent strings).
wikirealms-cta-cite-tooltip: Tooltip cite invite. $1 band name; $2 comparison.
wikirealms-cta-cite-field-barren: Ledger field task for barren section. $1 band name.
wikirealms-cta-cite-field: Ledger field task for thin section. $1 band name; $2 comparison.
wikirealms-cta-cite-topic-named: Quoted section title. $1 is the title.
wikirealms-cta-cite-seed-section: Action to seed a barren section. $1 is topic phrase.
wikirealms-cta-cite-add-section: Action to add citations to a section. $1 is topic phrase.
wikirealms-cta-grow-small-notice: Field task for a short article.
wikirealms-cta-grow-small-label: Action to enlarge a short article.
wikirealms-cta-become-editor: Link text to Wikipedia introduction help.
wikirealms-ledger-panel-state: Hidden meter title. $1 is panel state id.
wikirealms-ledger-peek-hint: Phone tip to pull the ledger up.
wikirealms-ledger-stale: Notice when Wikipedia revised the article.
wikirealms-ledger-hide-summits: Collapse nested summits. $1 is range title.
wikirealms-ledger-show-summits: Expand nested summits. $1 is range title.
wikirealms-ledger-subsection-range: Closed-range summary. $1 subsection count phrase; $2 lowest band; $3 highest band.
wikirealms-ledger-about: Accessible ledger label. $1 is article title.
wikirealms-helm-legend-aria: Accessible name for the Legend control on the helm.
wikirealms-legend-pin-section-suffix: Text after the italic section name in a legend pin.
wikirealms-legend-pin-portal-prefix: Text before the italic portal destination in a legend pin.
wikirealms-stat-words: Word-count chip. $1 is the formatted number; $2 is the raw count for plural.
wikirealms-stat-no-refs: Sources chip when there are zero references and zero sentences.
wikirealms-stat-no-refs-in-sentences: Sources chip with no refs but some sentences. $1 is sentence count.
wikirealms-stat-refs: Sources chip with refs but no sentences. $1 is ref count.
wikirealms-stat-subsections: Subsection count chip. $1 is the count.
wikirealms-stat-portals-leave: Portals leaving this section. $1 is the count.
wikirealms-section-untitled: Fallback title for a section with no heading.
wikirealms-portal-to: Label above a portal destination title.
wikirealms-portal-blurb: Short explanation under the portal destination.
wikirealms-portal-click: Hover hint on a portal marker.
wikirealms-creature-views: Creature hover title. $1 is compact pageview count.
wikirealms-ledger-own-words: Own-prose count under a selected row. $1 is the words phrase.
wikirealms-ledger-aggregate-why: Explanation for the synthetic aggregate range row.
wikirealms-ledger-read-section: Outbound link to a section on Wikipedia. $1 is the section title.
wikirealms-postcard-empty: Empty state when there is no trail to share.
wikirealms-postcard-toast-image-fail: Toast when postcard image creation fails.
wikirealms-postcard-toast-image-copied: Toast when postcard image is copied.
wikirealms-postcard-toast-image-download: Toast when image downloads because clipboard is unavailable.
wikirealms-postcard-toast-letter-copied: Toast when letter text is copied.
wikirealms-trail-somewhere-new: Open search from the trail panel.
wikirealms-info-contribute-aria: Accessible name for the contribute footer.
wikirealms-world-travel-to: Title on a 2D portal marker. $1 is the destination title.
wikirealms-settings-rendering-low: Settings option for lower rendering quality.
wikirealms-trail-lede: Introductory paragraph when the trail has stops.
wikirealms-trail-key-junction: Trail map legend: multiple inbound routes.
wikirealms-trail-key-start: Trail map legend: searched start, not walked to.
wikirealms-trail-ways-in: Inbound route count on a trail stop. $1 is the count.
wikirealms-trail-searched: Label for a trail stop opened via search.
wikirealms-postcard-stats: Graphic postcard stats line. $1 realms; $2 portals.
wikirealms-postcard-aria: Accessible name for the postcard SVG. $1 is the current realm title.
wikirealms-postcard-tagline-1: First mission line on the graphic postcard.
wikirealms-postcard-tagline-2: Second mission line on the graphic postcard.
wikirealms-postcard-more: Elided stops marker. $1 is how many titles were skipped.
wikirealms-postcard-letter-heading: First line of the shareable postcard letter.
wikirealms-postcard-letter-mission: Closing mission sentence in the postcard letter.
wikirealms-postcard-share-title: Share sheet / Web Share title for a trail postcard.
wikirealms-loading: Accessible label for the loading spinner.
wikirealms-info-tab-how-worlds: Field Guide tab: how worlds are generated.
wikirealms-keymap-group-general: Shortcut list heading for uncategorized bindings.
wikirealms-keymap-group-view: Shortcut list heading for view/chrome controls.
wikirealms-error-load-article: Fallback when article fetch fails without a specific message.
wikirealms-error-build-world: Fallback when world generation fails without a specific message.
wikirealms-error-generate-world: Fallback when world generation throws without a message.
wikirealms-error-import-snapshot: Fallback when trail/snapshot import fails without a message.
wikirealms-section-miscellaneous: Display title for the folded leftover-sections peak (engine id stays Miscellaneous).
wikirealms-info-start-lead: Field Guide › Start here: opening sentence.
wikirealms-info-start-trail: Field Guide bullet. May include Your trail.
wikirealms-info-start-callout: Field Guide callout. May include Legend and L.
wikirealms-info-journey-open: Field Guide › Journey: open trail tip. May include Your trail.
wikirealms-info-journey-share: Field Guide › Journey: share tip. May include … labels.
wikirealms-info-how-lead: Field Guide › How worlds form: opening sentence.
wikirealms-info-how-portals: Field Guide › How worlds form: closing portals note.
wikirealms-info-about-by: About tab credit line. May include Moriel Schottlender.
wikirealms-info-about-source: Link text to the GitHub repository.
wikirealms-info-about-site: Link text to moriel.tech (brand URL; usually left untranslated).
wikirealms-info-about-credits-body: Credits sentence. $1 fish pack link; $2 Quaternius link; $3 town kit link; $4 Kenney link.
wikirealms-info-shortcuts-lead: Keyboard tab intro above the generated shortcut list.
